description: Use this when the user wants to change a formula on their bench: add or remove a material, set an amount or a bottle strength, swap a material, flag or note a line, reorder, or scale the whole formula. Changes the working copy in place, as one hand edit in the editor does. No version is made; undo_last_change reverses the change, save_version keeps a version when the user asks. Only when a batch was made from the working copy does the first change start one new working version (the result says so). A formula open in the app updates within seconds. Lines are named by material or id. For add/set_amount always specify unit: g is a weighed amount; % is the final weighed share of the whole formula (including solvent, not the pure aromatic relative/absolute percent). Other weighed lines are held fixed; several % targets are solved together. Never copy relativePct or absolutePct as grams. Read get_formula first and use weighedPct for this kind of percentage edit.

formula.description: The formula: its id (from list_formulas) or its exact name.

amount.description: Amount in the explicit unit; never infer grams from a percentage.

line.description: The line: its material name or line id.

lines.description: For reorder: lines in their new order.

newMaterial.description: Only for a material the catalog does not have: create it as the user's own material.

unit.description: For add/set_amount: g or % for a weighed formula, part/drop only for a line already in that native unit. Legacy omission keeps its native unit, never percent.

name: edit_formula
title: Edit a formula's lines
